prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 4:5 high-key fashion fantasy portrait of one original approved adult woman and one Doberman in a seamless white studio.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, serious direct gaze, natural skin texture, white layered feather wings, a white fashion corset-style bodysuit with lace detail, translucent white gloves, glossy white thigh-high boots, and a delicate pearl-like choker. A muscular black-and-rust Doberman stands alert beside her wearing a black leather collar with supplied silver studs and a heavy silver chain leash.
composition_elements: Woman crouches beside the dog, holding the chain leash while the dog stands upright at the right side of the frame.
Large white wings fill the upper-left and counterbalance the dense dark dog mass on the right.
Seamless cool light-gray studio wall transitions to a white floor; keep both subjects isolated and fully readable.
Preserve wing feather detail, dog coat texture, collar studs, chain, boots, gloves, and fashion pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Controlled high-key studio lighting with cool neutral fill, soft floor shadows, crisp feather and coat highlights, and restrained dark-glamour contrast without haze.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full or three-quarter shot, 50mm lens at f/5.6, high-resolution detail, realistic feather, leather, metal, dog fur, fabric, and skin texture, subtle natural grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 4:5 high-key fashion fantasy studio portrait of one original approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, serious direct gaze, natural skin texture, large layered white feather wings, a white fashion corset-style bodysuit with lace detail, translucent white gloves, glossy white thigh-high boots and a delicate pearl-like choker. Beside her, a muscular black-and-rust Doberman stands alert wearing a black leather collar with supplied silver studs and a heavy silver chain leash held by the woman. She crouches beside the dog in a controlled editorial pose. Use a seamless cool light-gray studio wall transitioning to a white floor, wings filling the upper-left and dog balancing the right side, high-key studio lighting, soft floor shadows, crisp feather and coat highlights, realistic materials, 50mm f/5.6, no text, no watermark.
